paragraphs.text: This Agreement is between Ashcombe Labs Ltd and Brightwater Devices Ltd.
Purpose. The Receiving Party will use Confidential Information only to evaluate a possible research collaboration (the "Purpose").
Representatives. The Receiving Party may share Confidential Information with its employees and advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by duties of confidentiality.
Compelled disclosure. If the law requires the Receiving Party to disclose Confidential Information, it will give the Disclosing Party prompt notice where legally permitted.
Return. On request, the Receiving Party will return or destroy Confidential Information.
Term. The obligations in this Agreement continue for 3 years after the Effective Date.
Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
